title: Check in has a door on the Space Manage page: a Check in shortcut beside Web editor and Menu and features opens the door code, the NFC link and Regulars

source.ref: Owner report 2026-10-20 ('where the fuck is check in'): no tab led to the Check in panel. ADR-1788

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. The old space.checkin catalog row was retired (LIVE-226) but its ?panel=checkin panel stayed, so nothing led to it. A Check in shortcut now sits in the Manage quick links and opens that panel in place. The catalog is untouched, so the LIVE-246 box count still holds.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('components/spaces/manage-quick-links.tsx','utf8');if(!s.includes(\"key: 'checkin', label: 'Check in'\")||!s.includes('panel=checkin')){console.error('LIVE-949: no Check in shortcut');process.exit(1)}"
